ideas.pitch: A precision-engineered 8-sensor IR reflectance line follower utilizing PID control algorithms on an ATmega328P microcontroller for maximum speed on complex curves.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 – Qualification and Round 2 – Final: Fastest completion time on a complex line track.
ideas.title: PID-Tuned High-Speed Line Follower
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses purely on the primary judging criteria of track completion time and path accuracy by optimizing closed-loop feedback instead of over-complicating software.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous compact chassis equipped with an adjustable sensor mount that seamlessly transitions between sharp-angle line following and obstacle-avoidance modes.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2 – Final: Qualified robots run again on a more complex track.
ideas.title: Dual-Mode Maze & Line Adaptive Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the harder final round layout by dynamically scaling motor speeds using multi-tier threshold calibration.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight ESP32-CAM based robot that uses low-resolution thresholded computer vision to track a colored line rather than traditional IR arrays.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 – Qualification and Round 2 – Final: Fully autonomous navigation via onboard sensors within a 25cm size limit.
ideas.title: OptiTrack Edge-Processed Vision Line Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Unusual physical vision approach for a standard line follower event that stands out during accuracy and path-following checks.

ideas.pitch: A high-torque, low-weight chassis designed with modular snap-in gear ratios to let the team quickly adapt top speed for qualification straight lines versus final round sharp turns.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 – Qualification and Round 2 – Final: Fastest completion time on a more complex track.
ideas.title: Modular Quick-Swap Gearbox Line Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the physical mechanical limits of the platform while staying entirely compliant with the 25cm x 25cm size constraint.

ideas.pitch: A line follower featuring a secondary floor-facing color sensor layout that detects designated checkpoint lines to automatically reset heading errors without manual intervention penalties.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 – Qualification and Round 2 – Final: Minimizing checkpoint penalties and maintaining path accuracy.
ideas.title: Checkpoint Recovery Fault-Tolerant Line Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Minimizes checkpoint time penalties explicitly highlighted in the judging criteria by automating error recovery on-board.
